- Committed and pushed db88982 (Flatten postgres bin discovery helpers) after lint/test passed.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh as requested; it updated current_tasks/current_tasks_done/task_history and sent the task email.

- If resuming later: either leave the post-switch .ralph state alone or commit it only if the next task explicitly wants that bookkeeping captured.

- Read prior Ralph progress: previous run ended after commit/push/task switch; known rm current_task.txt noise remains from task_switch.
- Opened improve-code-boundaries skill instructions.
- Next: inspect found_smells and choose the mandated single boundary issue to flatten under src/ or tests/.

- Explored src/tests for a single boundary smell.
- Rejected production WorkerError cleanup for this run because WorkerError is a repo-wide string bucket and would fan out beyond one targeted boundary issue.
- Chose smell 5 in tests/cli_binary.rs: duplicate binary-path resolution helpers model the same concept twice; next is to replace them with one shared resolver and update callers.

- Replaced duplicate cli/node binary lookup helpers in tests/cli_binary.rs with one shared binary_path resolver; updated all callers.
- Ran focused validation with cargo nextest run --test cli_binary; all 10 tests passed.
- Next: run make lint and make test, then commit/push including .ralph files and finish with task_switch.

- make lint passed.
- make test passed: 242 tests run, 242 passed, 16 skipped, with the pre-existing 5 leaky tests still reported by nextest.
- Next: stage tests/cli_binary.rs plus current .ralph files, commit, push, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.
